description: This file defines the RestaurantProvider class, which manages fetching and storing restaurant and menu data for a Flutter application, including state management via ChangeNotifier.

classes.name: RestaurantProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages fetching and maintaining the list of restaurants and their menus.
